structural_change: QHUB-S1 10-19 SAFE successor of hbm_hcq_hub_1017 (its --cts gate 10-19 03:42 FAILED: CTS rc137 after a 4 h repair stall at WNS -155 ps / TNS -93 ns and trial GRT rc137, one 48.7k-flop root over 734.4 sq at ~10% util with pin flops anchored on all 4 faces, reset nets 2,193 / 1,063 / 299 loads, runtime part-select, calendar->issue_sector 678 ps / 17 lv, 1,600 s_i input endpoints > 3 lv). Structure: every std cell in ONE central band (432.0 um at 151.2..583.2, PARALLEL wider band, gpl region released before DPL, no face anchoring) so the single clock root serves a compact register mass; RTL SAFE 1: s_i pin register (+1 subtree edge, handed to the root as QCHX 12 and the programme as RAW0 179: HC_QSI=1), reset relay copies spread <= 32 loads (reset_relay_split), decoded assembly writes, gathered bounds precompute (0 edges), valid-only LG steering, 64 capture-enable copies, per-face beat-control copies; SRAM on the 43.2 lattice; pins/outline = the d4g contract (unchanged). Pin order: route.pin_balance {group_max 1} gives every face a defined, sorted bit order (gate pin_order; the hub<->bank joint ranges follow the die lead's open ring-vs-U geometry decision, unchanged from 1017).
